question: Which bīja syllables are placed on the thumbs and index fingers in this nyāsa?
premises: The syllables oṃ krā are placed on the thumbs
The syllables oṃ krī are associated with the index fingers
This forms part of the ritual placement
inference: The nyāsa places oṃ krā on the thumbs and oṃ krī with obeisance on the index fingers.
plain_english: Placing oṃ krā on the thumbs, and oṃ krī with obeisance on the index fingers.
